summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Do not clear security-sensitive releases or new public exposure. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security control evidence for authentication, access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependencies, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness is unavailable. This is an evidence gap, not proof of compromise. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition and security-sensitive release gates
items.summary: Keep new public exposure and security-sensitive releases gated while completing the read-only security evidence matrix. Ordinary reversible growth may continue within existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, claims, and dependency boundaries.
items.requested_action: Use authorized metadata and retained artifacts only to document authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container/runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS configuration evidence, data exposure, incident and monitoring signals, and security.txt or disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, collect new telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
